decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-1708c9a8a9a2], is a one-line release-note title that points to PR #6630. It says XR children are now named "in a deterministic way", but not what the naming scheme was before or is now. It also doesn't say which resources or compositions are affected (applicability) or what happens to existing composed resources when an operator does nothing, such as renaming, recreation, orphaning or no effect (consequence). To decide, we need the PR description or an upgrade-guide entry that gives the before and after naming and its effect on existing XRs.
